summary: Blue Owl Capital Corp filed an 8-K to report the issuance of $400 million in 6.300% notes due 2031 via an Eleventh Supplemental Indenture. The notes are unsecured general obligations, redeemable at the company's option at Treasury plus 35 bps before the Par Call Date, then at par. Proceeds will repay existing debt under a revolving credit facility and 3.400% notes due 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
